# secureaccess_dlp_builtin_classifications (Data Source)

This resource reads DLP Builtin Classifications.
 If `items` is empty, all DLP Builtin Classifications are returned, otherwise only the listed ones.
 If `filter` is provided, only DLP Builtin Classifications matching the filter are returned.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "secureaccess_dlp_builtin_classifications" "example" {
  items = {
    "Built-in PCI Classification" = {
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (String) Case-insensitive substring used to filter DLP builtin classifications by name.
- `items` (Attributes Map) Map of DLP Builtin Classifications. The key of the map is the name of the individual DLP Builtin Classification. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Id of the DLP Builtin Classification.
